problem_statement: The linked list utility methods that match entries (search, remove, remove-all) only accept a single indicator argument, so callers cannot pass multiple criteria to the entry's Matches() method. For example, calling RemoveAllMatching with the destination list first and then matching arguments, or calling FindMatchingWithPrev with two matching arguments, does not compile. Support passing a variable number of matching arguments to these template methods so that entry classes can provide Matches() overloads with multiple parameters.
